$schema_note: Deploy-time and runtime SSOT for Cloudflare Pages app-plane response headers. Backend assembly always overwrites the candidate _headers file from this manifest, and functions/_middleware.js enforces the same values at the edge because Pages advanced mode ignores static _headers. Frontend source must not emit an independent production header policy. The API worker keeps a stricter JSON-only CSP, while its HSTS ramp must match this manifest. Edit app headers only here; verify-app-security-header-parity.mjs proves manifest, assembled artifact, middleware, API HSTS, and live parity.
